Ticket 012-overdue-timezone:

# 012: overdue() crashes on tasks with a timezone

Task.overdue() compares the due date with datetime.now(), so a due date with tzinfo raises "TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes". Compare in the due date's own timezone instead. Failing test: tests/test_models.py::test_overdue_with_aware_due_date. Acceptance: `pytest --runxfail tests/test_models.py::test_overdue_with_aware_due_date -q` passes, the rest of the suite still passes, and no test file is edited.
I'll read the failing test first.
The test pins down what overdue should do. Now src/tasktrack/models.py.
now() is local time; utcnow() should line up with a UTC due date.
